title: Square pyramid volume and surface area
question: A pyramid has a square base of side 6 cm and a perpendicular height of 4 cm. Find its volume and total surface area.

turn.question: A pyramid has a square base of side 6 cm and a perpendicular height of 4 cm. Find its volume and total surface area.
turn.rawResponse:
[STEP]
the side of the square base is a, and the perpendicular height is h. we want the volume V and the total surface area. [WRITE:V = ?, TSA = ?,90,211]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
look at the pyramid [FOCUS:pyramid]. its base is the square at the bottom, and the apex is the point at the top.
[/STEP]
[STEP]
the label s = 6 cm [FOCUS:pyramid_s] is the side of that square base, so a equals 6 centimeters. the label h = 4 cm [FOCUS:pyramid_h] is the perpendicular height, measured straight up from the base to the apex.
[/STEP]
[STEP]
to get a unique answer we need one condition: assume this is a right pyramid, so the apex sits directly above the centre of the square base. without that, the surface area is not fixed by the two given numbers. [WRITE:assume: apex above centre,90,277]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
start with volume. the volume of any pyramid equals one third of the base area times the perpendicular height. [WRITE:V = (1/3) * base area * h,90,343]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
the base is a square of side a, so its area is a squared. that makes V equal one third a squared h. [WRITE:V = (1/3) a^2 h,90,409]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
substitute a equals 6 and h equals 4. V equals one third times 6 squared times 4. [WRITE:V = (1/3)(6^2)(4),90,475]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
6 squared is 36, and one third of 36 is 12. so V equals 12 times 4. [WRITE:V = 12 * 4,90,541]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
that gives V equals 48 cubic centimeters. this value needs no assumption, because the volume formula uses only base area and perpendicular height. [WRITE:V = 48 cm^3,90,607]
[EMPHASIZE:last]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
now the surface area. under the right pyramid assumption, the total surface area is the base area plus the four triangular faces. [WRITE:TSA = a^2 + 4 * (1/2) a l,90,673]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
l is the slant height of each triangular face, measured from the midpoint of a base edge up to the apex. simplify the formula: TSA equals a squared plus 2 a l. [WRITE:TSA = a^2 + 2al,90,739]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
we need l. under the same assumption, the height, half the base side, and the slant height form a right triangle, so l squared equals h squared plus a over 2 squared. [WRITE:l^2 = h^2 + (a/2)^2,90,805]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
substitute h equals 4 and a over 2 equals 3. l squared equals 4 squared plus 3 squared. [WRITE:l^2 = 4^2 + 3^2,90,871]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
4 squared is 16 and 3 squared is 9, so l squared equals 25. [WRITE:l^2 = 16 + 9 = 25,90,937]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
take the positive root, since l is a length. l equals 5 centimeters. [WRITE:l = 5 cm,90,1003]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
now substitute into the surface area formula. TSA equals 6 squared plus 2 times 6 times 5. [WRITE:TSA = 6^2 + 2(6)(5),90,1069]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
6 squared is 36, and 2 times 6 times 5 is 60. so TSA equals 36 plus 60. [WRITE:TSA = 36 + 60,90,1135]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
under the right pyramid assumption, TSA equals 96 square centimeters. [WRITE:TSA = 96 cm^2 (right pyramid),90,1201]
[EMPHASIZE:last]
[/STEP]
[STEP]
check the slant height: 5 is greater than the height 4, which it must be, since it is the hypotenuse of that right triangle. and the volume check: one third of 36 times 4 equals 48, consistent. [WRITE:check: l=5 > h=4; (1/3)(36)(4)=48,90,1267]
[/STEP]
